title: I have dreams of my grocery store but it’s not just a grocery store.. and a giant airport
content: inside the grocery store they have a library, a miniature disney world, and a lot of restaurants and shops so maybe it’s like the giant mall But I’m also ALWAYS dreaming that i’m in the same airport and it’s not too far from the store i go to and i don’t go in every dream, sometimes i do.. I’m also always going to one of two different schools, and i’m never supposed to be there because i graduated but i fit in with the students so i just walk around. And very consistently if i leave the school i know how to get to the store/mall, or i can take a different road to the airport, or i can go to my grandparents house, my moms house, or my dads house and it’s all within a decent bike ride
